## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run CodeGemma 2B (v1.0) (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.6 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF/tree/8978e8846f2638de9d7a1d280ec7162d30b137fb))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~2.7 GB) `llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run CodeGemma 2B (v1.0) (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.6 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF/tree/8978e8846f2638de9d7a1d280ec7162d30b137fb))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~2.7 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/codegemma-2b-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~2.2 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/codegemma-2b-4bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run CodeGemma 2B (v1.0) (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.6 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/codegemma/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run codegemma:2b-code-q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~2.7 GB) `ollama run codegemma:2b-code-q8_0`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run CodeGemma 2B (v1.0) (4bit, needs ~2.2 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/codegemma-2b-4bit/tree/a946ef789099ecdfb73ccb59e6f21bb7255f3f6c))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/codegemma-2b-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/codegemma-2b-4bit
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/google](https://huggingface.co/google/codegemma-2b)
